import {
  FaBroadcastTower,
  FaBuilding,
  FaChartPie,
  FaComments,
  FaFlask,
  FaMicrochip,
  FaRobot,
  FaRocket,
  FaUsers,
} from 'react-icons/fa';

export const buildings = [
  {
    id: 'tea-stall-rig',
    name: 'Tea Stall Mining Rig',
    emoji: 'chai',
    baseCost: 120,
    baseIncome: 85,
    startLevel: 1,
  },
  {
    id: 'broken-laptop-farm',
    name: 'Broken Laptop Farm',
    emoji: 'lap',
    baseCost: 380,
    baseIncome: 240,
    startLevel: 1,
  },
  {
    id: 'whatsapp-trading',
    name: 'WhatsApp Trading Group',
    emoji: 'WA',
    baseCost: 920,
    baseIncome: 610,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'sewer-gpu',
    name: 'Sewer GPU Setup',
    emoji: 'GPU',
    baseCost: 2200,
    baseIncome: 1550,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'meme-basement',
    name: 'Meme Basement',
    emoji: 'LOL',
    baseCost: 5100,
    baseIncome: 3600,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'underground-exchange',
    name: 'Underground Exchange',
    emoji: 'DEX',
    baseCost: 14500,
    baseIncome: 11200,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'meme-factory',
    name: 'Meme Factory',
    emoji: 'M',
    baseCost: 44000,
    baseIncome: 28600,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'influencer-agency',
    name: 'Influencer Agency',
    emoji: 'VIP',
    baseCost: 118000,
    baseIncome: 78500,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'ai-trading-lab',
    name: 'AI Trading Lab',
    emoji: 'AI',
    baseCost: 380000,
    baseIncome: 280000,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
  {
    id: 'cockroach-tower',
    name: 'Cockroach Tower',
    emoji: 'HQ',
    baseCost: 1250000,
    baseIncome: 960000,
    startLevel: 0,
  },
];

export const marketUpgrades = [
  {
    id: 'meme-marketing',
    name: 'Meme Marketing',
    description: 'Boost tap income with viral reels, uncle forwards, and street-level chaos.',
    rarity: 'Rare',
    baseCost: 850,
    startLevel: 1,
    icon: FaBroadcastTower,
  },
  {
    id: 'mutation-lab',
    name: 'Mutation Lab',
    description: 'Passive income mutates upward after every upgrade cycle.',
    rarity: 'Epic',
    baseCost: 1600,
    startLevel: 0,
    icon: FaFlask,
  },
  {
    id: 'telegram-army',
    name: 'Telegram Army',
    description: 'Referral rewards scale as your colony spreads through group chats.',
    rarity: 'Viral',
    baseCost: 2600,
    startLevel: 0,
    icon: FaUsers,
  },
  {
    id: 'sewer-mining',
    name: 'Sewer Mining',
    description: 'Improves offline rewards and keeps rigs alive during app downtime.',
    rarity: 'Epic',
    baseCost: 4200,
    startLevel: 0,
    icon: FaMicrochip,
  },
  {
    id: 'political-connections',
    name: 'Political Connections',
    description: 'Unlocks special event insurance when bans and raids hit the market.',
    rarity: 'Legendary',
    baseCost: 9200,
    startLevel: 0,
    icon: FaBuilding,
  },
  {
    id: 'ai-trading',
    name: 'AI Trading',
    description: 'Late-game multiplier that front-runs weak memecoins before breakfast.',
    rarity: 'Mythic',
    baseCost: 21000,
    startLevel: 0,
    icon: FaRobot,
  },
];

export const researchTracks = [
  { id: 'viral-memes', name: 'Viral Memes', baseCost: 2500, startLevel: 0, icon: FaComments },
  { id: 'blockchain-speed', name: 'Blockchain Speed', baseCost: 3800, startLevel: 0, icon: FaRocket },
  { id: 'gpu-efficiency', name: 'GPU Efficiency', baseCost: 4700, startLevel: 0, icon: FaMicrochip },
  { id: 'toxic-mutation', name: 'Toxic Mutation', baseCost: 7200, startLevel: 0, icon: FaFlask },
  { id: 'ai-automation', name: 'AI Automation', baseCost: 11500, startLevel: 0, icon: FaRobot },
  { id: 'market-manipulation', name: 'Market Manipulation', baseCost: 17000, startLevel: 0, icon: FaChartPie },
];

export const events = [
  {
    id: 'market-crash',
    name: 'MARKET CRASH',
    badge: 'Survive',
    multiplier: 0.95,
    tapBoost: 1.25,
    description: 'Another memecoin died today. Cockroach Coin turns panic into tap rewards.',
    notification: 'Cockroach Coin survived another crash.',
  },
  {
    id: 'bull-run',
    name: 'BULL RUN',
    badge: '2x',
    multiplier: 2,
    tapBoost: 1.15,
    description: 'Green candles everywhere. Even your broken laptop farm is feeling rich.',
    notification: 'WhatsApp uncles investing heavily.',
  },
  {
    id: 'meme-festival',
    name: 'MEME FESTIVAL',
    badge: 'Tap',
    multiplier: 1.2,
    tapBoost: 2,
    description: 'The colony found the perfect sticker pack. Tap rewards are temporarily wild.',
    notification: 'Meme market pumping hard.',
  },
  {
    id: 'government-ban',
    name: 'GOVERNMENT BAN',
    badge: 'Drama',
    multiplier: 0.8,
    tapBoost: 1.4,
    description: 'Restrictions hit, but the sewer datacenter does not read circulars.',
    notification: 'Government failed to stop infestation.',
  },
  {
    id: 'whale-attack',
    name: 'WHALE ATTACK',
    badge: 'Alert',
    multiplier: 1.35,
    tapBoost: 0.9,
    description: 'A whale tried to dump the chart. The colony is absorbing liquidity.',
    notification: 'A whale attack turned into free marketing.',
  },
];

export const dailyRewards = [
  { day: 1, coins: 500, gems: 1, mutationPoints: 0 },
  { day: 2, coins: 1500, gems: 1, mutationPoints: 0 },
  { day: 3, coins: 4000, gems: 2, mutationPoints: 0 },
  { day: 4, coins: 9000, gems: 2, mutationPoints: 1 },
  { day: 5, coins: 18000, gems: 3, mutationPoints: 1 },
  { day: 6, coins: 42000, gems: 5, mutationPoints: 2 },
  { day: 7, coins: 125000, gems: 12, mutationPoints: 5 },
];

export const leaderboard = [
  { name: 'Mumbai Whale', title: 'Dark Web Exchange Baron', coins: 982500000 },
  { name: 'Bengaluru Bot King', title: 'AI Trading Lab Maxed', coins: 654200000 },
  { name: 'Delhi Degen Sabha', title: 'MemeCoin Parliament Speaker', coins: 488000000 },
  { name: 'Chennai Chain Chad', title: 'Quantum Datacenter Owner', coins: 320500000 },
  { name: 'Kolkata Candle Lord', title: 'Influencer Army Commander', coins: 219400000 },
];

export const serverEconomyContract = {
  user: ['telegramId', 'username', 'coins', 'gems', 'buildings', 'upgrades', 'referrals', 'stats', 'lastSeenAt'],
  building: ['name', 'level', 'income', 'timer', 'unlockStatus'],
  research: ['category', 'level', 'bonuses'],
  event: ['activeEvent', 'multiplier', 'duration'],
  antiCheat: [
    'Server owns coin deltas',
    'Client sends intent only',
    'Telegram initData is verified on every session',
    'Offline rewards are capped and timestamped on Redis',
  ],
};
